info.title: CDK Drive Get Repair Order
info.description:
# CDK Drive Get Repair Order

The CDK Drive Get Repair Order API retrieves repair order data from the CDK data source.

# What does this API do?
The CDK Drive Get Repair Order API allows you to retrieve Repair Order data using two different methods: Bulk – returning all open Repair Order records, the last 31 days of closed Repair Order records or a combination of open and recently closed Repair Order records (work in process). Delta - returning all changed Repair Order records in which a change has been identified since the specified start date or date range limited to a date range of yesterday and today (UTC). If the endDate is omitted, data will be retrieved from the specified startDate through today.
